body.def: The desired compiler is constructed from oriented rank-two segment charts, distinct- and equal-endpoint rank-one charts, explicit inactive-row support faces, projective endpoint transfers, and residual-ratio forest propagation. For a real observable input \(\zeta\), it works over \(\mathbb K_{\zeta}\) and returns target agreement tests, exact target encodings, or legal target-changing lifts.
